newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-DVORAK PULLS OUT OF HEPTATHLON WITH INJURY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-DVORAK PULLS OUT OF HEPTATHLON WITH INJURY.

text.p: Decathlon Olympic bronze medallist Tomas Dvorak of the Czech Republic pulled out of the heptathlon at the indoor athletics world championships with an injury on Sunday.
Dvorak was lying third in the heptathlon, with two events remaining, after winning the 60 metres hurdles. But he hurt his ankle in the race and retired before the pole vault competition.

With the pole vault and the 1,000 metres still to come, American Chris Huffins was in the lead with 4,580 points. Jon Magnusson of Iceland was second on 4,571 points and Czech Robert Zmelik was third on 4,481 points.
